mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_play_history ( user_id, bet_point, result, result_type, earned_point, played_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{betPoint}, #{result}, #{resultType}, #{earnedPoint}, #{playedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, bet_point, result, result_type, earned_point, played_at FROM game_play_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY played_at DESC
